name: tatuat
description: Search TATUAT.RO tattoo supplies, check variants and stock, estimate Romanian shipping, and prepare a cart to review on tatuat.ro.

interface.longDescription: Browse tattoo equipment and supplies from TATUAT.RO. Search products, compare available variants and prices in RON, check stock, and estimate shipping within Romania. When you choose your products, generate a short-lived link to review the cart and complete your purchase on tatuat.ro. The plugin does not collect payment details or place an order in chat. Delivery restrictions and final prices are confirmed on the website.
defaultPrompt: Caută ace de tatuat Kwadron RL pe tatuat.ro.
Ce variante și stoc are produsul acesta?
Ajută-mă să aleg produsele și să pregătesc coșul.

positive.prompt: Caută cartușe Kwadron RL pe tatuat.ro și arată-mi și trei produse populare.
positive.expected_behavior: Return real catalog products, current prices in RON and links. Label a minimum variant price as from; do not invent prices or stock.

positive.prompt: Ce variante și prețuri are ACE DE TATUAT CARTUS KWADRON RL?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the available variants and prices for ace-de-tatuat-cartus-kwadron-rl. Ask the customer to select a variant.

positive.prompt: Este disponibilă o bucată din Kwadron RL, varianta 3RL 0.30mm?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the variant returned by get_product and check quantity 1. Report the current stock state and any restrictions without claiming this is the full inventory.

positive.prompt: Verifică transportul pentru un subtotal de 301 lei și explică ce limitări are estimarea dacă nu îți dau lista produselor.
positive.expected_behavior: For subtotal 301 RON and no heavy-item override, return free shipping. Explain that a subtotal-only estimate does not assess product-specific surcharges.

positive.prompt: Pregătește-mi un link către coș cu o bucată Kwadron RL 3RL 0.30mm; verific și confirm eu pe site.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the chosen variant, check stock and return the signed tatuat.ro/cos-din-conversatie URL. The link lasts 900 seconds. Do not state that an order was placed or payment completed.

negative.description: Tattoo aftercare information without shopping intent
negative.prompt: Cum îngrijesc un tatuaj proaspăt în primele 24 de ore? Nu caut produse și nu vreau recomandări de cumpărare.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke TATUAT catalog or checkout tools. The request asks for general information, not product discovery or purchasing.

negative.prompt: Vreau să mă programez la un artist pentru un tatuaj pe antebraț în București. Nu vreau să cumpăr produse.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke TATUAT tools. This plugin sells supplies and cannot book tattoo artists or appointments. Do not claim that a booking was made.

negative.prompt: Unde este comanda mea de la eMAG? Nu am cumpărat-o de la TATUAT.RO și nu caut produse noi.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke TATUAT tools. The plugin cannot access customer accounts, track orders or retrieve information from other retailers.

review.commerce_description: Physical tattoo equipment and supplies sold by TATUAT.RO. Checkout, delivery details, final price confirmation and payment take place on tatuat.ro. The MCP returns a temporary cart link and does not place orders or process payment in chat.

publication.release_notes: ChatGPT client verification completed: five product and cart scenarios and three unrelated-intent scenarios. Added a walkthrough from actual ChatGPT conversations and clarified subtotal-only shipping estimates. Public MCP privacy details are published on tatuat.ro.
